title: Update 18-hole Callaway shipped grid defaults and localStorage migration

requirements.summary: Replace shipped 18-hole 13x5 grid defaults with the user-provided 13-row table so fresh installs load the updated chart.
acceptanceCriteria: With empty browser localStorage, the 18-hole chart displayed in the app matches the provided 13-row table values.
The default 18-hole grid remains exactly 13 rows x 5 columns and passes existing grid validation (numeric values; worstHoles in 0.5 increments; non-negative).

file_operations.description: Update getDefault18GridChart() to encode the new shipped 18-hole grid values exactly matching the provided 13-row table (row number + five (grossScore, worstHoles) pairs), while keeping the grid shape 13x5 and the existing validation expectations.

Update the developer guide to reflect that the shipped 18-hole defaults now match the new 13-row table and that defaults are sourced from getDefault18GridChart() when localStorage has no applicable stored chart.

requirements.summary: Adjust localStorage migration so previously shipped 18-hole defaults cached in localStorage are cleared and replaced by the updated shipped defaults, while preserving user-edited charts.
acceptanceCriteria: If localStorage contains the previous shipped 18-hole grid defaults, the app clears that stored shipped-default data and loads the updated shipped 18-hole defaults.
If localStorage contains a user-edited 18-hole chart (non-shipped-default), the app preserves it and does not overwrite it with shipped defaults.

file_operations.description: Enhance migrateOldShippedDefaults(18) to detect the previous shipped 18-hole grid (by exact match to a frozen copy of the old shipped default grid values) and remove it from both the active and user-default localStorage keys, without removing non-matching (user-edited) charts; ensure this migration runs before reading charts in getActiveGridChart().
Document the migration behavior: old shipped-default 18-hole localStorage values are cleared so updated shipped defaults take effect, while user-edited charts are preserved.

requirements.summary: Ensure all user-facing UI strings touched by these changes remain English in chart editing, validation, and save/reset messaging.
acceptanceCriteria: No new non-English user-facing strings are introduced in the modified areas (including admin chart editor success/error/reset confirmations).

file_operations.description: Audit and, if needed, adjust any chart save/reset/validation strings impacted by the defaults/migration update to ensure they remain English-only and consistent with existing messaging.

Verify that any referenced guidance text related to chart defaults/persistence remains English after documentation and defaults updates, and adjust wording only if required to keep messaging accurate and English-only.
